consumer: The frontend map renderer that paints each nearby tile, asking 'which item stacks lie on the ground at these tiles so I can draw their symbols on the map?'
scope: a map region around the avatar (the per-tile ground stacks within the export window), NOT the character's own carried inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) iterates tiles via points_in_radius and serializes each tile's get_map().i_at(p) ground stack (type_id/name/symbol/charges) for the frontend to display
divergence: Avatar carries a flashlight in their backpack while a rock lies on an adjacent ground tile: the map must paint the rock on that tile and not the flashlight; a wrong carried-inventory authority (mission crafting_inventory / dialogue has_item) would surface the flashlight and miss the rock on the ground
